name: goat-scrapbook
description: Scrapbook Sticker · Наалттай цомог: puts the clips on a cream paper page inside taped Polaroids that land on a pile, turns the member's photos into white-edged stickers (die-cut round the subject when the background is removed), adds a price circle, a marker title and handwritten Mongolian notes, with stop-motion hops, built on HyperFrames. Renders a 1080x1920 MP4 for Reels/TikTok.
